crossRefs.note: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of…
“If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,
For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, Neither has he hidden his face from him; but when…
For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.
How much less will I answer him, And choose my words to argue with him?
If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’
“With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.
He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.
We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.
The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.
Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.
God has made the earth by his power. He has established the world by his wisdom, and by his understanding has he…
great in counsel, and mighty in work; whose eyes are open to all the ways of the children of men, to give everyone…
but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

translations.web: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.
translations.bsb: Indeed, God is mighty, but He despises no one; He is mighty in strength of understanding.
translations.kjv: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: he is mighty in strength and wisdom.
translations.asv: Behold, God is mighty, and despiseth not any: He is mighty in strength of understanding.
